📍 Diagonal 197, Barcelona, Spain 🇪🇸

A striking modern building on Avenida Diagonal, known for its bold geometric design and glass façade. Architecture here keeps surprising you, from Gothic streets to contemporary landmarks.

Would you explore it?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Barcelona #Spain

📍 Rastoke, Slunj, Croatia 🇭🇷 

Famous for wooden watermills, old houses and waterfalls flowing between them.

Here, the Slunjčica River spills into the Korana, creating a village built around rushing water.

Would you wander these riverside paths?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Croatia #Rastoke

📍 Marine City, Busan, South Korea 🇰🇷 

Glass skyscrapers rise beside the sea, creating one of Busan’s most striking skylines. 

After dark, the towers shimmer across the waterfront. 

Would you enjoy this oceanfront city view?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Busan #SouthKorea

📍 Florence, Italy 🇮🇹 

The Arno River reflects centuries of history, with terracotta rooftops and historic bridges shaping the skyline. 

The famous Ponte Vecchio connects the riverbanks with shops built right along it. 

Would you watch sunset here?
#Travel #TravelPhotography #Florence #Italy

📍 Victoria, Australia 🇦🇺 

These towering limestone stacks rise from the Southern Ocean along the Great Ocean Road. 

Despite the name, there were never twelve, and waves continue reshaping the cliffs. 

Would you watch the sunset here?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Australia #GreatOceanRoad

📍 Hallstatt, Austria 🇦🇹 

Pastel houses hug the shore of Lake Hallstatt, backed by steep Alpine mountains.

This storybook village is famous for its centuries-old salt-mining history and picture-perfect waterfront.

Would you spend a weekend here?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Austria #Hallstatt

📍 Split, Croatia 🇭🇷 

From Marjan Hill, terracotta rooftops meet the blue Adriatic, with the historic old town stretching toward the harbor. 

Diocletian’s Palace sits at the heart of this ancient coastal city. 

Would you enjoy this view?

#Travel #TravelPhotography #Croatia #Split
